scientific_integrity: A complete algebraic proof and executable deterministic diagnostic checks are provided. Finite checks do not prove the continuum theorem. No independent mathematical validation or historical-priority certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two repeated seasons, deterministic Beverton–Holt recruitment, fixed total fishing mortality, proportional post-recruitment removal and long-run biomass yield; no stochasticity, economics, minimum stock bounds, or uncertainty. Historical priority qualified by accessible materials.
title: A sharp seasonal allocation law for fixed-budget Beverton–Holt harvesting
